_comment: Corrections where OSM is wrong or missing, and facades read off Mapillary street photos (CC BY-SA 4.0). point = any block inside the building. facade: base material for the first baseFloors floors, upper material above, optional vertical bands every bandEvery blocks.

buildings.name: The Standard at Gainesville
buildings.source: User photo + Mapillary: tan stone-veneer ground floor with the Chick-fil-A at the corner, cream body, stacked glass balcony bays with white slab edges, red-brick piers; roof (user aerial photo): glass railing all round, pool deck with palms, planters, hot tubs, pergolas and loungers at the University Ave corner, rows of dark condensers elsewhere; colours per the user's comparison: warm cream stucco, tan stone base, red-brick piers
